## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech, Energy, Financials positive vs Communication, Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary negative) and extreme concentration in top performers (Leadership: Narrow — 5/5 Technology in Top 5), supporting a neutral reading rather than directional risk-on/off.

2. Which sectors are leading?

Energy is positive: XOM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -1.17%) RECOVERY, CVX (1W: +2.91% | 1M: -1.33%) RECOVERY. Financials showing selective strength: GS (1W: +8.83% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.77% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -12.37% | 1M: -18.44%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.27% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -8.42% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION, KHC (sentiment bearish) showing pressure. Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -7.38% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -7.87% | 1M: +32.88%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?

Note major divergence across large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA, INTC showing 1W vs 1M disagreement) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE and argues for tactical caution and confirmation before adding beta.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on headline winners; ORCL (1W: +16.02% | 1M: +27.51%) ABOVE TREND and PANW (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +51.95%) ABOVE TREND vs AAPL (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +9.62%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -4.18%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth positive overall (Technology 1W: +4.29% across 24 stocks) but watch narrow leadership and negative sentiment on AVGO/MSFT.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive and bifurcated: GS (1W: +8.83% | 1M: +19.43%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +4.77% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, while card names V (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -0.37%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -3.08%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +1.85% (20 stocks) — supportive for selective financial exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare steady with selective strength: UNH (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +8.96%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +8.42% | 1M: +5.32%) ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION and LLY (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +13.99%) CORRECTION require monitoring. Sector 1W: +0.67% (17 stocks) and bullish news for BMY/GILD supports constructive backdrop.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Tech winners and select Financials while reducing exposure to lagging Communication and weak Consumer Staples names; keep position sizing guarded given narrow leadership. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — prioritize conviction trades and watch for confirmation given the MAJOR divergence across large caps.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
